stanza: It is a gift so bitter that you brought to me
'Cause I feel what they're feeling and I know that they're free
And the freedom they take is the earthly burden
Tell me life's a passing cloud
Cover me up, lay me down

empathy.line: Sunbather, moon chaser, queen of empathy
stanza: Sunbather, moon chaser, queen of empathy
I give myself two seconds to breathe
And go back to being a serene queen
I just needed two seconds to be me

empathy.line: And I'm insensitive, and I lack empathy
empathy.linePrev: The jig is up, I seen you from a mile away losin' focus
empathy.lineNext: He looked at me and said, "Your potential is bittersweet"
